title: alkekengi procumbens
intro: Alkekengi procumbens, commonly known as Chinese lantern, is a flowering plant native to East Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Alkekengi procumbens include reducing fever, relieving pain, and soothing respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
